# Green Point Logistics (GPL)

> Green Point Logistics is a freight forwarding and customs clearance company based in Alexandria, Egypt, founded in 2021 and part of Three Stars Group. One team handles sea freight, air freight, customs clearance, inland container haulage, domestic trucking, warehousing, RORO and last-mile delivery through the ports of Alexandria, Dekheila, Damietta, Port Said and Sokhna. GPL is a FIATA member. The site is in English and Arabic.

Head office: Al-Riyada School Street, Sidi Gaber, Smouha City Plus 2 Project, First Floor, Second Part, Apartment No. 2, Alexandria, Egypt.
Phone: +20 3 426 6445, +20 3 426 6411. Mobile and WhatsApp: +20 122 221 0198.
Email: ms@gpl.com.eg, info@gpl.com.eg (general), import@gpl.com.eg (imports), export@gpl.com.eg (exports).

## Services

- [All services](https://gpl.com.eg/services): overview of every service, one team and one invoice
- [Sea freight](https://gpl.com.eg/sea-freight/): FCL, LCL and consolidation to and from the Egyptian ports
- [Air freight](https://gpl.com.eg/air-freight/): urgent, high-value and time-critical cargo to and from Egypt
- [Customs clearance](https://gpl.com.eg/customs-clearance/): import and export clearance in Egypt, ACI on Nafeza, HS codes, duties and VAT, inspection, free zones
- [Inland transportation](https://gpl.com.eg/inland-transportation/): container haulage from the ports to factories and warehouses across Egypt
- [Domestic trucking](https://gpl.com.eg/domestic-trucking/): full and part truckloads across Egypt
- [Warehousing](https://gpl.com.eg/warehousing/): storage, inventory management and distribution in Egypt
- [RORO services](https://gpl.com.eg/roro-services/): roll-on/roll-off shipping for cars, trucks and machinery
- [Last-mile delivery](https://gpl.com.eg/last-mile-delivery/): final delivery to customers in Egypt with proof of delivery

## Company

- [About Green Point Logistics](https://gpl.com.eg/about-greenpoint/): history and Three Stars Group
- [Industries](https://gpl.com.eg/industries): garments and QIZ exports, food and agri, chemicals, furniture, engineering cargo
- [Ports and network](https://gpl.com.eg/network): the Egyptian ports GPL clears through and the sea lanes to Europe, the US, Asia and Africa
- [Contact](https://gpl.com.eg/contact-us/): phones, email desks, WhatsApp and office address
- [Request a quote](https://gpl.com.eg/quote): send cargo, route and ready date
